# vyos.blueprints.bonding

Bonding (LAG/LACP) interfaces

- Creates bonding interfaces with their members, mode and hash policy.
- Run before `vyos.blueprints.base` so that VLANs and addresses on the bond (e.g. `bond0.201`) can be configured there.
- Uses vyos.vyos.vyos_lag_interfaces and vyos_interfaces.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.bonding
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bonding_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Bonding interfaces. Nothing is configured when empty. |
| `bonding_interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | Bond name, e.g. `bond0`. |
| `bonding_interfaces.description` | str |  |  | Interface description. |
| `bonding_interfaces.mode` | str |  |  | Bonding mode, e.g. `802.3ad`. |
| `bonding_interfaces.hash_policy` | str |  |  | Transmit hash policy, e.g. `layer2`. |
| `bonding_interfaces.members` | list | yes |  | Member interfaces, e.g. `[eth0, eth1]`. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every bond is up.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bonding_interfaces` | list | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
